lines.trans: Manager Kim, did you come alone?
Because I told President Byun to come in.
The president is overseas, so...
I asked where overseas.
She went to South America.
Aw, let's just let it slide, PD.
Aw, the stage wasn't bad...
I asked where President Byun is right now?
Manager Byun, is this your first day working?
You don't need to relay every single thing those people say to me.
Cut it off at your end.
Tell them to take them out.
We only need to go on M and S.

I want to travel to South America.

넘어가다.gloss: to let it pass, to move on

meanings.en: to let it pass, to move on

examples.trans: I will let it slide this time.
Let's move on to the next.
I will speak as the representative.
I have a lot of work.
What kind of work do you do?
I was sick for two days.
Please be careful with your words.

일일이.gloss: one by one, every single detail

meanings.en: one by one, every single detail

examples.trans: I can't explain every single detail.

없다.gloss: to not exist, to not have

meanings.en: to not exist, to not have

examples.trans: Do you want to come too?
